resourceTemplates.description: A single client (customer) by id, with contacts and linked matters. Org-wide read.
resourceTemplates.name: client

resourceTemplates.description: A single matter (project) by id, with your role on it. Project-access gated.
resourceTemplates.name: matter

resources.description: The firm's AI grounding profile: practice areas, jurisdiction, risk calibration, and house-style / fee-estimation notes. Requires the AI_MANAGE capability.
resources.name: firm-profile

tools.description: Attach a document to an inbound correspondence using a two-phase presigned upload. Call with phase=INITIATE (correspondenceId + fileName) to get a presigned PUT URL and a documentId, PUT the bytes to that URL, then call again with phase=CONFIRM (documentId + correspondenceId) to finalise. The document is stamped with the correspondence link and source=EMAIL_INGEST. CONFIRM is idempotent on documentId. Requires the MCP_WRITE capability.

correspondenceId.description: Correspondence id to attach the document to.

tools.name: attach_document

tools.description: File an inbound email into a matter and/or client. Provide at least one of matterId or customerId. Idempotent on messageId â re-filing the same messageId is a no-op that returns the existing correspondence id. Requires the MCP_WRITE capability.

customerId.description: Client (customer) id to file the email against.

matterId.description: Matter (project) id to file the email into.

messageId.description: Stable RFC-822 Message-ID or externalId â the idempotency key.

receivedAt.description: When the email was received (ISO-8601 instant).

sentAt.description: When the email was sent (ISO-8601 instant).

threadKey.description: Provider thread key to group the conversation.

tools.name: file_correspondence

tools.description: List the firm's audit events, newest first. Optionally filter by eventType (prefix match, e.g. 'invoice.') and/or clientId (matches events on the client record itself). Paginated â page size capped at 200. Requires the TEAM_OVERSIGHT capability.

customerId.description: Filter to events on this client (customer) record.

eventType.description: Filter by event type, prefix match (e.g. 'invoice.').

tools.name: get_audit_events

tools.description: Fetch one client (customer) by id, including its contact details and the matters linked to it. Returns a non-leaking not-found error if the client does not exist.
tools.name: get_client

tools.description: Fetch one filed correspondence (email) by id, INCLUDING its body (bodyText/bodyHtml) and headers (to/cc/from, subject, messageId, threadKey). Returns a non-leaking not-found error if it does not exist OR you cannot access it.
tools.name: get_correspondence

tools.description: Return a short-lived presigned download URL (plus its expiry in seconds) for one document. Never returns the document bytes. Returns a non-leaking not-found error if the document does not exist or you cannot access it.
tools.name: get_document_url

tools.description: Fetch one invoice by id, including its line items and payment events. Line items and payments are capped at 50 each; the 'truncated' flag is set when either was clipped. Money is returned as minor units plus a currency code. Returns a non-leaking not-found error if the invoice does not exist. Requires the INVOICING capability.
tools.name: get_invoice

tools.description: Fetch one matter (project) by id, including your role on it. Returns a non-leaking not-found error if the matter does not exist OR you cannot access it.
tools.name: get_matter

tools.description: List the activity timeline for one matter (project), newest first. Project-access is enforced â a non-member receives a non-leaking not-found error. Paginated â page size capped at 50.
tools.name: get_matter_activity

tools.description: Get a trust balance for a trust account. If a clientId is supplied, returns that client's ledger-card balance on the account; otherwise returns the account's total trust balance. Money is returned as minor units (e.g. cents) plus a currency code. Requires the VIEW_TRUST capability and the trust-accounting module â a firm without trust accounting receives a clean module_disabled error.

customerId.description: Client (customer) id â omit for the account total.

tools.name: get_trust_balance

tools.description: Summarise unbilled work. Without a matterId, returns a firm-wide list of up to the first 50 clients with unbilled work (optionally bounded by periodFrom/periodTo and currency); if `truncated` is true, narrow the result using the period/currency filters. With a matterId, returns a single per-matter unbilled summary. Money is returned as minor units plus a currency code. Requires the INVOICING capability.

projectId.description: Matter (project) id â switches to the per-matter summary.

tools.name: get_unbilled_time

tools.description: Health probe â returns 'ok'. Proves the read-only tool surface is wired.
tools.name: kazi_ping

tools.description: List the firm's clients (customers), org-wide. Optionally filter by lifecycleStatus (PROSPECT, ONBOARDING, ACTIVE, DORMANT, OFFBOARDING, OFFBOARDED). Paginated â page size is capped at 50.

lifecycleStatus.description: Filter by lifecycle status short enum name, e.g. ACTIVE.

tools.name: list_clients

tools.description: Summarise a client's compliance posture: FICA verification status plus their open checklist items (name, status, required). The item list is capped at 50; the 'truncated' flag is set when clipped. Returns a non-leaking not-found error if the client does not exist. Requires the CUSTOMER_MANAGEMENT capability.
tools.name: list_compliance_gaps

tools.description: List filed correspondence (emails) for ONE matter (matterId) OR ONE client (customerId) â provide exactly one. Returns metadata rows (subject, from, receivedAt, attachmentCount, direction) newest-first; use get_correspondence(id) for the body. Paginated â page size is capped at 50. Returns a non-leaking not-found if the matter/client does not exist OR you cannot access it.

customerId.description: List correspondence for this client (customer) id.

matterId.description: List correspondence for this matter (project) id.

tools.name: list_correspondence

tools.description: List the firm's invoices, optionally filtered by clientId, status (DRAFT, APPROVED, SENT, PAID, VOID) and/or matterId. Money is returned as minor units plus a currency code. Paginated â page size capped at 50. Requires the INVOICING capability.

status.description: Filter by status: DRAFT, APPROVED, SENT, PAID, VOID.

tools.name: list_invoices

tools.description: List the firm's matters (projects) visible to you. Members see only assigned matters; owners/admins see all. Optionally filter by status (e.g. ACTIVE) or customerId. Paginated â page size is capped at 50.

customerId.description: Filter to matters linked to this client id.

status.description: Filter by short status enum, e.g. ACTIVE.

tools.name: list_matters

tools.description: List a client's trust transactions on a trust account, newest first. Money is returned as minor units plus a currency code. Paginated â page size capped at 50. Requires the VIEW_TRUST capability and the trust-accounting module.
tools.name: list_trust_transactions

tools.description: Propose a task/deadline from a filed email. Creates a PENDING approval gate only â it NEVER creates the task directly; an authorised member must approve it in Kazi (AI_REVIEW) before the task is created. Idempotent per open gate: a second proposal for the same correspondence returns the existing gate. Requires the MCP_WRITE capability.

correspondenceId.description: Correspondence id the task is proposed from.

projectId.description: Matter (project) id the task belongs to.

tools.name: propose_task

tools.description: Resolve an inbound correspondence email to the firm's client (customer) and ALL of that client's matters. Pass the sender email; returns {customer, matters[]} so you can pick the right matter before filing. Returns {customer:null, matters:[]} when no client matches. subjectHint/reference are optional hints for YOUR disambiguation only â Kazi does no server-side fuzzy matching.

email.description: Sender email address to resolve to a client.

reference.description: Optional reference/matter number, a hint for your own disambiguation only.

subjectHint.description: Optional email subject, a hint for your own disambiguation only.

tools.name: resolve_matter_by_email

tools.description: List document metadata (never the bytes). Provide projectId to search one matter (project-access enforced), or scope=ORG / scope=CUSTOMER for org-wide search (customerId is required when scope=CUSTOMER). Paginated â page size capped at 50.

scope.description: Org-wide scope: ORG or CUSTOMER. Ignored when projectId is given.

tools.name: search_documents
